messages.text: Build a fantasy battle: a heroic knight named Muse in silver armor fights a huge red dragon on a rocky cliff at sunset. Over 10 seconds the dragon swoops in and breathes fire, Muse dodges left, then charges and strikes. Give me three shots: a wide orbiting establishing shot, a low-angle hero push-in on Muse, and an over-the-shoulder shot from behind the dragon.

Fantasy cliff battle built: Muse the knight vs huge red dragon on rocky sunset cliff. 10s action with swoop, fire breath, dodge, charge and strike. 3 consecutive shots: wide orbit, low hero push-in, dragon over-shoulder.

asset.name: Heroic Knight Muse
